Immersive Blackouts: Settings
Electricity Check Cooldown
Cooldown (in hours) between possible electricity shutoffs and restorations.
Electricity Shutoff Chance

Chance (in percent) that electricity will be shut off.
This chance is checked every 10 minutes.
Electricity Restore Chance

Chance (in percent) that electricity will be restored.
This chance is checked every 10 minutes.
Electricity Shutoff Day Range

Sets the day range for a random electricity shutoff.
Format: minimum day - maximum day (for example: 0-30).
Changes the vanilla 'Electricity Shutoff' day setting.
Days Before Electricity Shutoff
How many days before the scheduled electricity shutoff random outages will begin.
Ignore Electricity Outage Start Day
If enabled, random power outages will occur regardless of the 'Days Before Electricity Shutoff' setting.
Ignore Water Outage Start Day
If enabled, random water outages will occur regardless of the 'Days Before Water Shutoff' setting.
Reset Mod Data

Enabling this option will reset the mod's saved data.
Only enable this if you have changed the day when the shutdowns will occur.
It will automatically disable afterwards.
Radio

Enables automatic emergency radio broadcasts from the Knox Emergency Regional Infrastructure Service on 89.2 MHz.
The radio will provide information about upcoming water and power outages, current infrastructure status, and other emergency events.
Water Check Cooldown
Cooldown (in hours) between possible water shutoffs and restorations.
Water Shutoff Chance

Chance (in percent) that the water supply will be shut off.
This chance is checked every 10 minutes.
Water Restore Chance

Chance (in percent) that the water supply will be restored.
This chance is checked every 10 minutes.
Water Shutoff Day Range

Sets the day range for a random water shutoff.
Format: minimum day - maximum day (for example: 0-30).
Changes the vanilla 'Water Shutoff' day setting.
Days Before Water Shutoff
How many days before the scheduled water shutoff random outages will begin.

OFF
